messages:
maya: Heads up — we need to decide sampling vs full export for routing/quota change history. On-demand UI downloads are slamming the read path during big rollouts.

samir: Are we covering scheduled S3 exports or the admin "download" button that queries live?

olivia: Both. UI-triggered downloads currently hit the same event-store query and it gets expensive quickly. S3 jobs help but still scan full time ranges.

leo: Do we actually need full field-level diffs for every change? Compliance asked for 'who changed what' — diffs are ideal but can be huge.

maya: Compliance specifically wants proof for audits, including previous value. Maybe we can precompute a compact diff per write for specific objects (routing policies, quotas, rollout configs).

samir: Precompute sounds good but increases write-path work. Idea: only precompute diffs for policy-ish objects and for actors in admin groups; sample others.

infra-bot: Proposal: implement async export jobs + export throttling. UX: start export -> returns job_id -> background job writes compressed NDJSON bundle to org S3 and notifies. Avoid live big queries.

olivia: Also need PII mode: orgs can choose to mask actor_email and ip. Export API must support pii_masking param and append metadata (masking_applied:true).

leo: From telemetry side we should bump audit_schema to v2 to include rollout_id, change_set_id, prev_state_ref, and route_hash. Backwards compat via schema registry and per-org feature flag.

samir: For the console UX, show compact inline diff and a link "show full diff" that lazily fetches the precomputed blob; don't load big diffs on initial page render.

maya: Implementation plan (draft):
1) Async export jobs for full history -> NDJSON gzipped archives in S3.
2) Streaming/sample endpoint for quick CSV preview (1% sample or time-bucketed).
3) Precomputed diffs for policy objects on write, stored zstd compressed and referenced by change_set_id.
4) Audit schema v2 + feature flag audit_v2 for rollout.

olivia: Also add quota & rate-limit headers on export endpoints and a soft quota with billing/notify to prevent accidental massive pulls. Add e2e tests for export vs retention policy.

export-bot: job 1891234567-01 created -> s3://redwood-audit-exports/1891234567-01.ndjson.gz (placeholder link)

audit-bot: Note: retention and legal holds must supersede deletion. Exports should carry retention metadata: {"retention_until":"2028-03-01","legal_hold":false}.

samir: Example NDJSON line for export preview:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-01T15:12:03Z","actor_id":"u_123","actor_email":"masked@example.com","org_id":"o_45","object_type":"routing_policy","object_id":"rp_9","change_set_id":"cs_777","diff":[{"path":"/rules/0/priority","old":10,"new":5}],"rollout_id":"r_12"}
```

maya: Nice. I will draft the design doc & open PR for schema + async job API. Will include rollout canary plan for audit_v2.

leo: Assigning follow-ups to maya + samir for infra + schema design.

olivia: I'll loop in compliance on the design doc for PII modes.

maya: Cool — will ping when PR ready. :thumbsup:
